sections.text: Giving a reason for a belief raises a question about the reason itself.

items: Suppose I believe a claim because a witness reported it.
If I have reason to doubt the witness, I still need grounds for accepting the report.
Skepticism holds that the regress leaves no belief justified.
Infinitism accepts an endless chain of distinct reasons.
Coherentism finds justification in a system of mutually supporting beliefs.

sections.text: What “I know” claims can depend on the conversation.

sections.quote: “Smith knows the flight stops in Chicago.”

rows.condition: The flight stops in Chicago, and Smith’s evidence (needs to) meet the ordinary standard. The printed schedule is enough.
The flight stops in Chicago, and Smith’s evidence (needs to) meet a higher standard. He needs enough evidence to confirm that the printed schedule is still current.

sections.text: A belief can settle a doubt when it is itself undoubted in that inquiry.

items: A premise can support a conclusion even if we could question the premise on another occasion.
This gives the foundationalist a reason to stop without requiring absolute certainty.

dialogue.L0:0:1u70wnw: Everything is made of belief. And belief is ink.
dialogue.L0:1:1soi8tx: Liquid ink is a belief still in doubt. Concrete ink is a settled belief you can build on.
dialogue.L0:2:ptr57c: Ink solidify when it holds up to questions. A question you can't answer can melt it again.
dialogue.regress-problem:0:jz884s: Every belief came from the Great Inkwell
dialogue.regress-problem:1:o0irx4: State your belief, answer the question, and the belief solidfy.
dialogue.L2:11:rwza9p: Her words never solidified. Then, slowly, neither did her hand.
dialogue.L3:2:1yq4kak: Every question that couldn't be settled split off another questioner. Nothing solidified, so the ink kept coming. The Great Inkwell overflowed, and every puddle it left behind became an inkwell of its own, with its own five.
dialogue.L3:18:1oj3xnq: And anything stayed in liquid long enough began to melt.
dialogue.regress-skepticism:3:dzmp3n: [Beside him, his old teacher Anaxarchus is sinking into the liquid ink, waving.]
dialogue.regress-infinitism:7:buc68m: The objection — at any finite time, the justification is still unfinished (Unit 1.1). Nothing ever solidifies.
dialogue.regress-foundationalism:8:bamr6v: [In his ladle, one grain of ink turns matte. SOWATT keeps asking. It stays solid.]
dialogue.regress-foundationalism:9:1pu7qi2: For the first time since the Whypocalypse began, a belief stayed solid even as the questions kept coming.
dialogue.L6-A:0:1wv9lhn: For the first time since the Whypocalypse, people had a way to fight back. The goal: solidify the world again, the way it used to be.
dialogue.L6-A:2:1qrfr3y: The Cartesians would solidify only what could not be doubted.
dialogue.L6-A:5:tod0kx: [A few grains of concrete ink fuse into one irregular pebble. Polite applause.]
dialogue.L6-A:6:yn8qg4: It was a very good stone. Nothing anyone asked could melt it. They are still deciding what to build.
dialogue.L6-B:0:fege8s: The moderates built on perception and some intuitions, even without certainty.
dialogue.L6-B:2:zmqpf5: But their ink only ever solidified halfway. Everything they built was jelly.
dialogue.L7:1:1cshpug: [A lone figure, seen from behind, steps out onto bare ink. A stick solidifies under her foot.]
dialogue.P2-6:7:we8ngd: [MY NAME IS SIMONE burns into the brass. The first plank of concrete ink snaps onto the frame.]
dialogue.L3:11:qzjkhs: Why should tomorrow be like today?
dialogue.L3:14:bskj5i: Why couldn’t a white raven be on its way?
dialogue.L3:15:1dhmpnd: So what? One white raven blows your rule away.
dialogue.L3-continued:3:1gbz8st: To the melted, demon will offer worlds of dream. They will step inside, and none of them will know they are dreaming.
dialogue.L4:0:63tgj9: For the first time in its history, humanity united. It elected the three greatest minds alive.
dialogue.L3-continued:2:2t6uie: And when the stones have melted, the Cartesian demon shall return.
dialogue.regress-foundationalism:10:11pbni: But it was the size of a grain of rice.
dialogue.L6-A:1:1dtnhzb: Overtime, people split into two schools.
dialogue.regress-problem-birth:0:hbzskl: But one day, the guardian was gone. In its place were five: YYYY SOWATT.
dialogue.L2:8:h027is: Why believe you're not a brain in a vat?
dialogue.L3:0:1v5k02q: Then the five became ten. Answers still came. They just never passed.
dialogue.regress-foundationalism:0:pg0oj4: And then there was a fourth. Nobody had elected him. He was shut alone in a stove-heated room, doubting everything.
dialogue.L7:0:1xawf6j: Until someone found a way out.
dialogue.P2-2a:0:596tqo: [Flash Back. Sunset. A sea wall. Cole is streaming, orange chat slips drifting around him.]
dialogue.P1:4:18duhxc: That gavel, Your Honor, is one of the legendary artifacts.
